module_summary: Scatter-gather DMA sequencer: an 8-state FSM reads table entries through a prefetch interface and writes source, destination, length and control words to a DMA controller over AXI-lite.

anchors.name: sgstate
anchors.why: Scatter-gather FSM stepping through table words, DMA start and wait states.

anchors.name: i_start
anchors.why: Starts table walk from IDLE, setting new pc and busy.

anchors.name: i_abort
anchors.why: Abort request; writes abort key to DMA or returns FSM to idle.

anchors.name: i_tbl_addr
anchors.why: Starting table address loaded into the prefetch pc while idle.

anchors.name: o_busy
anchors.why: Level busy indication while walking the table; gates prefetch ready.

anchors.name: o_done
anchors.why: Completion pulse when table walk ends, aborts or errors.

anchors.name: o_int
anchors.why: Interrupt on DMA complete with last/int-enable entry or illegal fetch.

anchors.name: o_err
anchors.why: Error flag on DMA error, abort or illegal prefetch.

anchors.name: o_tbl_addr
anchors.why: Current table entry address, advanced by TBL_SIZE after control word.

anchors.name: o_new_pc
anchors.why: Pulse telling prefetch to restart at o_pf_pc on start, skip or jump.

anchors.name: o_pf_clear_cache
anchors.why: Clears prefetch cache when idle, done or aborted.

anchors.name: o_pf_ready
anchors.why: State-decoded ready accepting table words when DMA write channel is free.

anchors.name: o_pf_pc
anchors.why: Prefetch program counter driven from r_pf_pc for table fetches.

anchors.name: i_pf_valid
anchors.why: Prefetch word valid; advances FSM through table entry words.

anchors.name: i_pf_insn
anchors.why: Table entry word forwarded as DMA register data; top bits decode last/skip/jump.

anchors.name: o_dmac_wvalid
anchors.why: AXI-lite write valid to DMA controller registers.

anchors.name: i_dmac_wready
anchors.why: DMA write ready; clears wvalid and frees next table word.

anchors.name: o_dmac_waddr
anchors.why: DMA register address selected per FSM state (src, dst, len, control).

anchors.name: o_dmac_wdata
anchors.why: DMA register write data: table words, control word or abort key.

anchors.name: o_dmac_wstrb
anchors.why: Write strobe; byte-3-only strobe marks abort-key write.

anchors.name: i_dmac_rdata
anchors.why: DMA status readback decoded into busy, done, abort, error bits.

anchors.name: tbl_last
anchors.why: Last-entry flag decoded from table word; ends walk after DMA.

anchors.name: tbl_int_enable
anchors.why: Per-entry interrupt enable gating o_int on DMA completion.

anchors.name: dma_busy
anchors.why: DMA busy status bit; blocks op complete and abort return.

anchors.name: dma_err
anchors.why: DMA error status bit; forces terminate and sets o_err.

anchors.name: dma_starting
anchors.why: Covers the cycle after DMA start write before busy is visible.

anchors.name: dma_aborting
anchors.why: Abort in progress during WAIT; forces terminate when DMA stops.

anchors.name: dma_op_complete
anchors.why: DMA transfer finished; lets WAIT state proceed to next entry or idle.

anchors.name: dma_terminate
anchors.why: Ends the walk after DMA: last entry, abort, error or illegal fetch.

groups.name: Scatter-gather FSM
groups.description: Table-walk state machine with last/int flags and DMA completion/termination logic.

groups.name: Control and status
groups.description: Start/abort commands, table address, busy/done/int/err status outputs.

groups.name: Prefetch interface
groups.description: Drives prefetch pc/restart and accepts table words with valid/ready.

groups.name: DMA register writer
groups.description: AXI-lite writes of DMA src/dst/len/control and status bit decode.
